name: app-lime-portfolio-performance-with-glow-curve
title: Investment app with lime-yellow glow curve and quiet grey UI
whatItIs: A light-grey board with a phone showing greeting, metrics for invested amount and returns, small progress bars and a performance chart with a glowing lime-to-yellow curve and a dashed vertical marker. Beside it float a chart card and an upcoming payouts list.
whatItMeans: Fresh, optimistic and precise; the glowing line makes growth the only colourful thing.
techniques: Give the main chart line a soft blurred halo in a warm gradient.
Use light numerals with a small greyed currency sign for elegant figures.
Break a tall UI into floating cards outside the phone to explain components.
Use a dark circular nav item as the only heavy element.

vocabulary.definition: A chart line with a soft luminous outline.
Components floated beside a device to explain them.
A dashed vertical rule showing a selected point.
A thin bar showing status next to a metric.
